title: Project OS Manifest (project.json)
description: Required in the repo root of every project published on Project OS. Validated on submit; missing or invalid manifest = can't publish.

name.description: Base name if this is a lineage root (e.g. "Subwolf"). Immutable down the lineage.

variant.description: Variant name if this is a fork (e.g. "Cyber" — displayed as "Subwolf // Cyber"). Omit for lineage roots.

description.description: What this project is, in plain words. Shown on the project card.

license.description: SPDX identifier (GPL-3.0-or-later, MIT, Apache-2.0, ...). Must match the LICENSE file in the repo.

howToRun.description: Markdown: exact steps to get this running from a fresh clone.

screenshots.description: Optional. Images are normally uploaded on the publish form and stored by Project OS; these are used only as a fallback.

lineage.description: Present on forks only. Verified against the GitHub fork graph on registration.

changeSummary.description: One line: what this fork changes vs. the parent.
